BULLETIN - EAS ACTIVATION REQUESTED
Tornado Warning
National Weather Service Fort Worth TX
712 PM CDT Tue Apr 28 2026

The National Weather Service in Fort Worth has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
  South central Johnson County in north central Texas...
  Northwestern Hill County in central Texas...

* Until 800 PM CDT.

* At 712 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a 
  tornado was located near Rio Vista, or 8 miles south of Cleburne, 
  moving southeast at 25 mph.

  HAZARD...Tornado and baseball size hail.

  SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

  IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without 
           shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. 
           Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree 
           damage is likely.

* Locations impacted include...
  Itasca, Covington, Parker, Rio Vista, Osceola, Lovelace, Woodbury,
  and Mayfield.

This includes Interstate 35W between mile markers 2 and 9.
 
PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...

This is a dangerous storm, capable of producing large hail driven by
severe winds! SEEK SHELTER NOW inside a sturdy structure and stay
away from windows! If you are caught outdoors, cover your head and
neck.
